title: Guttmann-Flury et al. 2025 (Motor Imagery) — Dataset combining EEG, eye-tracking, and high-speed video for ocular activity analysis across BCI paradigms
description: This dataset contains 64-channel EEG recorded during a two-class motor imagery task (left vs. right hand grasping) from 31 healthy participants across up to three sessions. It is the motor imagery subset of a multimodal collection that also includes eye-tracking and high-speed video, which were used to analyze ocular activity across BCI paradigms. Each session has 40 cued trials, and the data are organized in BIDS with HED event annotations.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Neuroscan Quik-Cap (64 EEG channels plus EOG) and a SynAmps2 amplifier at 1000 Hz, referenced to the right mastoid. Participants saw a visual rectangle cue and then performed 4 s of left- or right-hand motor imagery, with 40 trials per session and no feedback.
